title: Rusty Puzzle
nothingSelected: Nothing is selected. Click a board cell or choose a party member.

noMoves: The {member} has no legal move from here.
solved: The whole party stands on the exit: room solved in {count} moves.
solvedNext: Go on to the next room, or undo or reset to play this one again.
solvedLast: That was the last room. Undo or reset to play it again.

refusals.incomplete: That command was missing something it needs.
refusals.stale-revision: The board changed before that command arrived; nothing was done.
refusals.off-board: That cell is not on the board.
refusals.no-such-member: That party member is not on this board.
refusals.illegal-move: That member's law does not allow that move.
refusals.room-solved: The room is already solved. Undo or reset to keep playing it.
